references.text: Introduces the curses that come upon those who do not keep the Lord's commands and statutes, which are elaborated in verse 58
Concerns reading from the Book of the Law every day to learn to fear the Lord your God and to keep all the words of this law
The people shall gather to hear the law and learn to fear the Lord and to keep all the words of this law
Command to fear the Lord your God, which is the central theme in Deuteronomy 28:58
God's name is revealed as eternal and glorious, linked to 'the great and awesome name' in the verse
The Lord's name is holy and awesome, corresponding with 'the great and awesome name'
The Lord is a great king, and his name is feared among the nations
The curses written in this Book of the Law shall come upon those who break the covenant
All nations shall come and worship before the Lord because his name is holy and awesome
